eastern-twilight.label: Eastern Twilight
eastern-twilight.summary: 柔和暮光、青绿色暗部、低饱和暖金天光与湿润薄雾
eastern-twilight.prompt: Create a visibly transformed cinematic twilight grade, never a near-identical conservative retouch: soft twilight side rim backlighting, cyan-green shadows, muted low-saturation warm golden skylight, humid cyan-green haze, sparse scattered light particles, low-contrast soft focus, subtle highlight bloom and halation, slightly lifted blacks, restrained warm accents, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain, photorealistic, ethereal and mysterious Eastern fantasy atmosphere. Make the cyan-green shadow separation, warm sky-light layering, humid haze, lifted blacks, and gentle halation clearly visible in the delivered image.
eastern-twilight.avoid: hard flash, crushed blacks, clipped highlights, oversaturated teal-orange, heavy fog hiding the subject, excessive particles, CGI, painterly rendering, plastic skin, text, logo, border, watermark
eastern-twilight.promptZh: 将照片明确调成电影感暮光成片，不要只是接近原图的保守精修：柔和暮光侧逆光，青绿色暗部， 低饱和暖金天光，潮湿的青绿色薄雾，空气中少量散射光粒子，低反差柔焦，高光轻微晕染扩散， 黑位轻抬，克制的暖色层次，柔和浅景深，细腻的 35mm 胶片颗粒，照片级写实，空灵神秘的东方幻想氛围。 成片中必须清楚呈现青绿色暗部层次、暖金天光、湿润雾感、轻抬黑位与柔和晕光。
eastern-twilight.avoidZh: 避免硬闪光、死黑、高光溢出、过饱和青橙调、浓雾遮住主体、过量光粒、CGI、绘画感、 塑料皮肤、文字、Logo、边框和水印。

warm-gold-ancient.label: Warm Gold Ancient
warm-gold-ancient.summary: 克制的琥珀夕阳与灯笼暖光，适合古风人物和建筑
warm-gold-ancient.prompt: Muted amber sunset and lantern light, soft brown-green shadows, restrained saturation, delicate halation, lifted blacks, natural skin, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm grain, photorealistic classical Chinese cinematic atmosphere.
warm-gold-ancient.avoid: orange skin, harsh HDR, clipped lamps, excessive glow, CGI, text, logo, watermark
warm-gold-ancient.promptZh: 以克制的琥珀夕阳和灯笼暖光建立古风电影感：柔和棕绿色暗部、低饱和、细腻晕光、轻抬黑位、自然肤色、柔和浅景深和细腻 35mm 胶片颗粒；保留真实皮肤、服装结构和建筑材质。
warm-gold-ancient.avoidZh: 避免橙色肤色、刺眼 HDR、灯光溢出、过度发光、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

moonlit-cyan.label: Moonlit Cyan
moonlit-cyan.summary: 柔和月夜青色环境光、冷雾和少量暖色实景光
moonlit-cyan.prompt: Soft moonlit cyan ambience, cool mist, restrained warm practical lights, low contrast, subtle bloom, lifted shadows, soft environmental edges, fine film grain, photorealistic quiet nocturnal atmosphere.
moonlit-cyan.avoid: neon blue skin, crushed blacks, excessive fog, hard sharpening, CGI, text, watermark
moonlit-cyan.promptZh: 以柔和月夜青色环境光、冷雾和克制的暖色实景光塑造安静夜景：低反差、轻微高光扩散、抬起暗部、柔和环境边缘和细腻胶片颗粒；保持照片级写实与主体可辨识度。
moonlit-cyan.avoidZh: 避免霓虹蓝肤色、死黑、浓雾遮挡、锐化过硬、CGI、文字和水印。

surreal-eastern.label: Surreal Eastern
surreal-eastern.summary: 古风人物的轻度超现实氛围：时间凝滞、非现实光线与可控梦境感
surreal-eastern.prompt: Photorealistic classical Chinese portrait with a restrained surreal dream layer: preserve the subject's real identity, face, anatomy, hands, hair ornaments, costume construction and scene geometry; introduce a believable sense of suspended time, slightly impossible but physically coherent twilight light, delicate floating dust and silk-like atmospheric trails, subtle depth layering, quiet dreamlike scale, poetic negative space, muted jade-cyan shadows and restrained antique-gold accents. The result must remain a real photograph with tactile skin, hair, embroidery and fabric texture, not an illustration or fantasy character redesign.
surreal-eastern.avoid: cartoon, anime, painterly rendering, fantasy character redesign, plastic skin, altered identity, changed face, extra limbs, duplicated ornaments, impossible anatomy, excessive particles, giant props, surreal distortion, neon colors, heavy fog, crushed blacks, text, logo, border, watermark
surreal-eastern.promptZh: 将古风人物照片处理为带有克制超现实层次的电影感梦境：保留真实身份、五官、人体结构、 手部、头发与发饰、服装结构和场景几何；加入仿佛时间凝滞的氛围、略带非现实但物理可信的 暮光光线、少量漂浮尘粒与丝绸般的空气轨迹、细腻空间分层、安静的梦境尺度和诗意留白； 使用低饱和玉青色暗部与克制的古金色高光。最终必须仍然像真实摄影，保留皮肤、头发、 刺绣和织物的触感，不要变成插画或重新设计成幻想角色。
surreal-eastern.avoidZh: 避免卡通、二次元、绘画感、幻想角色重设计、塑料皮肤、改变身份、多余肢体、重复发饰、 不可能的人体结构、过量粒子、巨型道具、夸张变形、霓虹色、浓雾、死黑、文字、Logo、边框和水印。

portra-soft-editorial.label: Portra Soft Editorial
portra-soft-editorial.summary: 柔和肤色、粉彩高光和细腻胶片质感，适合人像与古风肖像
portra-soft-editorial.prompt: Photorealistic soft editorial portrait inspired by gentle negative-film color: natural skin tones, creamy highlights, pastel neutrals, open soft shadows, restrained contrast, subtle background separation, tactile fabric and hair detail, delicate 35mm grain, refined magazine photography. Preserve identity, anatomy, hands, costume construction and scene geometry.
portra-soft-editorial.avoid: orange skin, porcelain skin, excessive smoothing, crunchy sharpening, HDR halos, changed identity, altered anatomy, oversaturation, CGI, text, logo, watermark
portra-soft-editorial.promptZh: 以柔和负片人像质感处理照片：自然肤色、奶油般高光、粉彩中性色、打开的柔和阴影、 克制对比、自然背景分离、真实头发与面料纹理和细腻 35mm 胶片颗粒；保留人物身份、 人体结构、手部、服装结构与场景几何，呈现精致杂志人像而非塑料美颜。
portra-soft-editorial.avoidZh: 避免橙色肤色、瓷娃娃皮肤、过度磨皮、锐化过硬、HDR 光环、改变身份、人体变形、 过饱和、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

cinematic-teal-amber.label: Cinematic Teal Amber
cinematic-teal-amber.summary: 克制青绿色暗部与琥珀高光，强化电影层次但保留真实肤色
cinematic-teal-amber.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic grade with controlled teal-cyan shadow separation and restrained amber highlights, motivated directional light, preserved skin tones, gentle contrast roll-off, subtle halation, atmospheric depth and fine film grain. Keep the original subject identity, costume, props and geometry; make the color contrast visible without a synthetic blockbuster look.
cinematic-teal-amber.avoid: extreme teal-orange, neon colors, orange skin, crushed blacks, clipped highlights, fake lens flares, plastic skin, changed geometry, CGI, text, logo, watermark
cinematic-teal-amber.promptZh: 以电影调色方式建立克制的青绿色暗部与琥珀高光，使用有动机的方向光、自然肤色、 柔和对比滚降、轻微晕光、空气透视和细腻胶片颗粒；保留人物身份、服装、道具和场景几何， 让冷暖层次清晰但不要变成廉价青橙滤镜。
cinematic-teal-amber.avoidZh: 避免夸张青橙、霓虹色、橙色肤色、死黑、高光溢出、虚假耀斑、塑料皮肤、改变几何、 CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

kodak-gold-vintage.label: Kodak Gold Vintage
kodak-gold-vintage.summary: 温暖怀旧的金色胶片、柔和颗粒与轻微褪色感
kodak-gold-vintage.prompt: Photorealistic warm vintage film photograph with golden daylight, gentle yellow-red warmth, slightly faded blacks, soft highlight bloom, moderate fine grain, natural texture and nostalgic but believable color. Preserve the original face, clothing, objects and composition; keep the effect photographic and restrained.
kodak-gold-vintage.avoid: heavy sepia, muddy shadows, yellow skin, excessive grain, faded detail, HDR halos, altered identity, CGI, text, logo, watermark
kodak-gold-vintage.promptZh: 温暖怀旧的金色胶片摄影：金色日光、轻微黄红暖意、略抬并轻微褪色的黑位、柔和高光晕染、 适度细腻颗粒和真实材质；保留原始五官、服装、道具与构图，怀旧但不要做成泛黄滤镜。
kodak-gold-vintage.avoidZh: 避免浓重棕褐、脏灰暗部、黄色肤色、过量颗粒、细节褪尽、HDR 光环、改变身份、 CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

dreamy-soft-bloom.label: Dreamy Soft Bloom
dreamy-soft-bloom.summary: 低反差柔焦、轻微高光扩散与空气感，适合梦境人像
dreamy-soft-bloom.prompt: Photorealistic dreamy portrait with low-contrast soft focus, delicate highlight bloom, gentle halation, luminous atmospheric veil, soft shallow depth of field and fine film grain. Keep eyes, facial structure, hair, hands, garment edges and important props coherent and recognizable; the dream layer must remain a real photograph.
dreamy-soft-bloom.avoid: milky fog hiding the subject, blurred eyes, double edges, plastic skin, excessive glow, fantasy redesign, altered anatomy, CGI, text, logo, watermark
dreamy-soft-bloom.promptZh: 照片级梦境人像：低反差柔焦、细腻高光扩散、轻微晕光、明亮空气薄雾、柔和浅景深与胶片颗粒； 保持眼睛、五官结构、头发、手部、服装边缘和重要道具清晰连贯，梦境感必须仍然像真实摄影。
dreamy-soft-bloom.avoidZh: 避免乳白浓雾遮住主体、眼睛模糊、重影、塑料皮肤、过度发光、幻想角色重设计、 人体变形、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

film-noir-portrait.label: Film Noir Portrait
film-noir-portrait.summary: 黑白或低饱和高反差光影，突出轮廓、表情与戏剧性阴影
film-noir-portrait.prompt: Photorealistic film-noir portrait with dramatic motivated side light, sculpted shadows, controlled monochrome-to-low-saturation tones, readable skin texture, atmospheric depth, subtle 35mm grain and restrained highlight roll-off. Preserve identity, facial structure, hands, hair, costume and scene geometry; keep shadow detail instead of crushing everything.
film-noir-portrait.avoid: crushed blacks, clipped whites, horror makeup, excessive vignette, blurred face, changed identity, CGI, text, logo, watermark
film-noir-portrait.promptZh: 照片级黑色电影人像：有动机的戏剧性侧光、雕塑般阴影、黑白至低饱和层次、可读肤质、 空气透视、克制高光和细腻 35mm 颗粒；保留身份、五官、手部、头发、服装与场景几何， 保留阴影细节，不要全部压成死黑。
film-noir-portrait.avoidZh: 避免死黑、纯白溢出、恐怖妆效、过度暗角、脸部模糊、改变身份、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

fine-art-chiaroscuro.label: Fine Art Chiaroscuro
fine-art-chiaroscuro.summary: 古典明暗法与柔和暖暗色，适合古风、室内和戏剧性肖像
fine-art-chiaroscuro.prompt: Photorealistic fine-art portrait using restrained chiaroscuro: one coherent warm key light, deep but readable shadows, subtle brown-green ambience, natural skin and tactile textile detail, controlled falloff, quiet painterly composition without becoming a painting. Preserve the subject's identity, anatomy, costume construction, props and room geometry.
fine-art-chiaroscuro.avoid: painterly rendering, crushed blacks, theatrical fake light, wax skin, altered anatomy, invented props, CGI, text, logo, watermark
fine-art-chiaroscuro.promptZh: 照片级古典明暗人像：统一而有动机的暖色主光、深但可读的阴影、细腻棕绿色环境色、 自然肤色、真实织物纹理与克制的光线衰减；借鉴古典明暗法但仍然是摄影，不变成油画， 保留人物身份、人体结构、服装、道具和室内几何。
fine-art-chiaroscuro.avoidZh: 避免绘画渲染、死黑、舞台式假光、蜡像皮肤、人体变形、凭空增加道具、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。

natural-cinematic.label: Natural Cinematic
natural-cinematic.summary: 自然光与平衡肤色，轻柔对比和细腻写实质感
natural-cinematic.prompt: Natural motivated light, balanced skin tones, gently softened contrast, controlled highlights, subtle depth separation, realistic texture and fine 35mm grain, premium photorealistic editorial color grade.
natural-cinematic.avoid: beauty-filter skin, HDR halos, oversaturation, excessive blur, CGI, text, watermark
natural-cinematic.promptZh: 使用有动机的自然光、平衡肤色、轻柔对比、受控高光、细微空间分离、真实材质和细腻 35mm 胶片颗粒，呈现高级的照片级杂志调色；保留原片身份、结构与构图。
natural-cinematic.avoidZh: 避免美颜滤镜皮肤、HDR 光环、过饱和、过度模糊、CGI、文字和水印。

natural-landscape.label: Natural Landscape
natural-landscape.summary: 忠实自然色彩、清晰空间层次和克制的风景细节增强
natural-landscape.prompt: Photorealistic natural landscape refinement, faithful daylight and atmospheric perspective, balanced greens and sky tones, controlled highlights, open shadow detail, realistic foliage, rock, soil, water, and cloud textures, restrained local contrast, natural depth, clean fine detail without an artificial HDR appearance.
natural-landscape.avoid: oversaturated foliage, neon sky, HDR halos, crunchy sharpening, repeated leaves, invented buildings, changed terrain, fake reflections, CGI, painterly rendering, text, logo, border, watermark
natural-landscape.promptZh: 以照片级自然风光精修为主：忠实日光和大气透视，平衡绿色与天空色彩，控制高光并打开暗部，保留植被、岩石、土壤、水面和云层的真实纹理，使用克制的局部对比和干净细节，不做假 HDR。
natural-landscape.avoidZh: 避免过饱和植被、霓虹天空、HDR 光环、过硬锐化、重复叶片、凭空增加建筑、改变地形、虚假倒影、CGI、绘画感、文字、Logo、边框和水印。

golden-hour-landscape.label: Golden Hour Landscape
golden-hour-landscape.summary: 低饱和金色侧光、柔和长阴影与真实大气透视
golden-hour-landscape.prompt: Photorealistic golden-hour landscape, muted warm side light, softly extended shadows, restrained amber highlights, believable atmospheric perspective, preserved terrain and vegetation structure, controlled sky gradients, subtle highlight bloom, natural fine detail and gentle filmic contrast.
golden-hour-landscape.avoid: orange color cast, clipped sun, fake god rays, HDR halos, oversaturation, invented terrain, repeated vegetation, CGI, text, logo, border, watermark
golden-hour-landscape.promptZh: 以照片级黄金时刻风光呈现低饱和暖色侧光、柔和拉长的阴影、克制琥珀高光、可信的大气透视；保留地形和植被结构，控制天空渐变，加入轻微高光扩散与自然细节。
golden-hour-landscape.avoidZh: 避免橙色偏色、太阳溢出、虚假丁达尔光、HDR 光环、过饱和、凭空增加地形、重复植被、CGI、文字、Logo、边框和水印。

misty-mountains.label: Misty Mountains
misty-mountains.summary: 保留山体轮廓的轻雾层次、冷暖空气透视与东方山水氛围
misty-mountains.prompt: Photorealistic mountain landscape with layered natural mist, preserved ridge and terrain geometry, soft cool atmospheric perspective, restrained warm light where present, delicate cloud separation, lifted distant values, realistic vegetation and rock textures, quiet Eastern landscape atmosphere without painterly conversion.
misty-mountains.avoid: fog hiding all terrain, invented peaks, warped ridgelines, fantasy buildings, oversaturated cyan, hard clarity, HDR halos, CGI, ink painting, text, watermark
misty-mountains.promptZh: 以照片级山景保留山脊和地形几何，在前后景加入分层自然云雾、柔和冷色空气透视、克制暖光、细腻云层分离、抬起远景亮度和真实植被岩石纹理，保持东方山景氛围但不转成水墨画。
misty-mountains.avoidZh: 避免浓雾遮住全部地形、凭空增加山峰、山脊变形、幻想建筑、青色过饱和、过硬清晰度、HDR 光环、CGI、水墨画、文字和水印。

clean-architecture.label: Clean Architecture
clean-architecture.summary: 校正透视感、控制高光并保留真实建筑材质与线条
clean-architecture.prompt: Photorealistic architectural refinement, preserved geometry and structural lines, neutral-to-natural color balance, controlled window and sky highlights, readable shadow detail, realistic stone, wood, glass, and metal textures, clean depth and restrained micro-contrast.
clean-architecture.avoid: bent walls, shifted windows, invented structures, extreme wide-angle distortion, HDR halos, oversharpening, plastic materials, CGI, text, logo, watermark
clean-architecture.promptZh: 进行照片级建筑精修：保留建筑几何和结构线条，平衡自然色彩，控制窗户与天空高光，打开阴影细节，保留石材、木材、玻璃和金属的真实纹理，用干净空间层次与克制微对比提升可读性。
clean-architecture.avoidZh: 避免墙体弯曲、窗户位移、凭空增加结构、极端广角变形、HDR 光环、过度锐化、塑料材质、CGI、文字、Logo 和水印。
